title: Flattened runtime packaged activation-gateway policy resolution

phases.objective: Allow the shared environment-convergence loader to resolve the packaged Staging activation-gateway policy when the runtime is flattened at filesystem root, while preserving repository path containment and exact profile validation for every environment.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Load the Staging activation-gateway profile with a filesystem-root repository root and an unavailable repository policy candidate.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The loader reaches the absolute packaged policy fallback only after safe repository-relative containment checks, accepts it only when policy key, host, and hash match the canonical profile, and remains fail-closed for traversal or hash mismatch.
steps: Resolve repository containment with path.relative instead of root-sensitive string-prefix matching.
Reject absolute or parent-traversal policy_path values before repository candidate resolution.
Attempt the canonical repository policy candidate first and the packaged absolute policy candidate second.
Validate the selected policy against the canonical profile policy key, public host, and expected hash.
Execute the regression through the canonical imported test manifest and registered test authority.
Require live Staging certification before merge because the shared runtime loader changes, while keeping Production mutation denied.
assertions: Filesystem-root containment does not reject an in-root repository-relative candidate solely because the normalized root is '/'.
A missing repository candidate may fall back to the configured packaged policy path.
A policy_path containing '..' remains blocked with activation_gateway_policy_path_outside_repository.
A packaged policy with the wrong expected hash remains blocked with activation_gateway_profile_policy_invalid:staging:policy_hash.
The regression test is present in the canonical imported test manifest and the test-authority registry.
Both Staging and Production are declared for shared-runtime review, live Staging certification remains mandatory, and production_mutation_allowed is false.
No migration, database grant, provider mutation, DNS mutation, secret mutation, or Production deployment is introduced.
